steps.text: Sameer is making a kite for the harvest festival. He needs a shape with four equal sides and four corners.
Which shape has four equal sides and four corners?
steps.hint: Count the sides and the corners.

steps.text: Right! A square has four equal sides and four corners. Sameer cuts two sticks to the same length and ties them at the corners.
Let us count. A triangle has three sides and a circle has none. A square has four equal sides and four corners.
He covers the frame with paper, ties a string at the centre, and the kite is ready for the wind.
Nice work! Four equal sides, four corners. Sameer's square kite is ready to fly.
